baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural act of saying at word 1, the definite opening at word 4, the conditional occurrence at word 6, and the truthful speakers at word 7 form a speech-event test.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question proposes that an announced beginning must enter time and thereby verify whether the speakers' words correspond to reality.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance supplies the claim whose public wording is being tested.
An initiating opening supplies the event that would begin a new phase rather than merely name an endpoint.
Occurrence and presence in time make realization, not verbal consistency alone, the proposed proof.
Correspondence between speech, inward commitment, and reported reality defines the challenge's truth criterion.

changed_reading.before: They ask when a promised event will happen.
changed_reading.after: They nominate the event's coming into time as the experiment that will make prior speech veridical or false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening at word 4 stands inside a verbal controversy that ends with a challenge about truth at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Opening can function as a ruling that breaks a closed dispute; the question then asks when the rival truth claims will receive judgment.

activation_trace.role: Judicial resolution supplies the decisive act that opens a deadlocked controversy.
Mutual speaking over an affair supplies the disputational setting that calls for settlement.
Truth against falsehood supplies the issue on which the settlement must rule.

changed_reading.before: The opening is access to something closed.
changed_reading.after: The opening is also a verdict that breaks open a controversy and identifies which speech corresponds to reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The named opening at word 4 is demanded as evidence for the truthful status asserted at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: A victory is not only reported but achieved; its arrival would turn an asserted promise into performed fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Triumph supplies the contestive outcome that the challengers demand to see.
Fulfillment in deed makes victory the performance of a word or promise.
Temporal realization distinguishes an achieved victory from one merely asserted.

changed_reading.after: Truth is a word fulfilled through an achieved victory, so the demand for timing is also a demand for performance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite opening at word 4 is the object of a temporal question, allowing the focus to be organized around a not-yet-passable threshold.
baseline_models.mechanism: A closure first blocks passage; an opening or access-enabling means then changes what can enter, leave, or become reachable.

activation_trace.role: Release of a closure supplies the spatial transition from blocked to passable.
A means of access supplies the enabling condition by which the closed threshold can actually be crossed.
Occurrence in time turns latent accessibility into an actual threshold event.

changed_reading.before: They request the date of a named outcome.
changed_reading.after: They ask when a still-blocked boundary will become passable and alter who or what can cross it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The saying at word 1 introduces an interrogative, while the opening at word 4 and truth at word 7 make uncertainty itself part of the scene.
baseline_models.mechanism: Interrogative speech can carry supposition rather than neutral inquiry; an opening of understanding would remove the conceptual blockage on which the challenge trades.

activation_trace.role: Speech operating like supposition, especially in a question, supplies the skeptical rather than purely informational force.
Removal of conceptual closure supplies an epistemic event that could expose what the question keeps doubtful.
Correspondence to reality is the point the skeptical probe withholds until an opening occurs.

changed_reading.before: The question asks for missing calendar information.
changed_reading.after: The question performs doubt and demands an opening of understanding as the condition for conceding truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated human sayings circulate as positions and denials; the sequence then presents a word made manifest, a consequence experienced, and a commanded answer. The focus question becomes one link in a movement from talk to enacted speech.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance supplies the challenged speech act inside the larger sequence.
A saying circulating among people supplies the earlier public allegation that the focus speech continues.
Making truth evident supplies the transition by which a word ceases to be only debated and takes effect.
The explicit word supplies the verbal content that the adjacent manifestation turns into an effective pronouncement.
Experiential testing supplies the conversion of what is said into something undergone.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the denied claim that is answered by experience rather than further debate.
The commanded utterance supplies the controlled answer that replaces the challengers' open-ended speech.

structural_cues: The packet repeats plural saying in 32:3, 32:10, and 32:28, but shifts to an effective word in 32:13, passive speech joined to consequence in 32:20, and an imperative answer in 32:29.
The focus's question-and-truth syntax sits at the end of this recurrent speech sequence rather than standing as an isolated request.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, changing grammatical voices, manifestation, and experienced consequence; I infer a directional move from circulating discourse to an enacted pronouncement. A live alternative is that the repetitions only stage dialogue and do not form a causal speech sequence.

changed_reading.before: The challengers ask one skeptical question about a future claim.
changed_reading.after: Their question is another turn in a circulating discourse that will be overtaken by a word whose truth is experienced rather than negotiated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first places an extraordinary day against human measurement and counting. That dislocates the scale presupposed by the focus's request for a date.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time keeps the question genuinely temporal while allowing the relevant scale to be contested.
A duration rather than merely daylight supplies an elastic temporal unit.
A measure reaching an assigned limit supplies the scale against which the day is specified.
Human enumeration supplies the limited counting frame that the extraordinary measure exceeds.

structural_cues: 32:5 explicitly contrasts a day measured as a thousand years with what the addressees count; 32:28 later asks 'when' without naming a scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the enlarged day, its measure, and human counting; I infer that the focus question imports an inadequate clock into the demand for proof. Alternatively, 32:5 may mark grandeur without directly criticizing the later question.

changed_reading.before: The uncertainty is which point on a shared calendar contains the opening.
changed_reading.after: The question also exposes a mismatch between the askers' counting scale and the scale on which the event is ordered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Granted faculties fail to yield understanding, later seeing and hearing produce certainty, and the final opening makes newly adopted belief useless. The opening can therefore be carried as an unveiling of reality whose recognition arrives too late.

activation_trace.role: Removal of an inward closure supplies the epistemic sense of the opening.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies a faculty whose mere possession need not become uptake.
Inward sight supplies perception deeper than optical exposure.
Belated inward seeing supplies the moment when denial can no longer maintain closure.
Belated understanding supplies the receptive counterpart to belated sight.
Knowledge fixed after doubt supplies the cognitive result of the unsealing.
The negative hearing question supplies a still-open opportunity for understanding before the final event.
The negative sight question supplies an immediately adjacent failure of insight.
Trustful assent supplies the response that becomes unavoidable only after unveiling.
The denial of benefit makes post-unveiling assent cognitively real but no longer effective.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from faculties granted in 32:9, to retrospective seeing, hearing, and certainty in 32:12, to failed hearing and sight in 32:26-27, and finally to useless belief in 32:29.
The focus asks for the opening immediately after the last negative sight question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated failure-then-certainty pattern and the focus root supplies inward unblocking; I infer that the event includes an epistemic unveiling. The live alternative is that altered perception is only a consequence of an external judicial or victorious opening.

changed_reading.before: The opening is an external event offered as proof.
changed_reading.after: The opening can also be the forced unsealing of perception: truth becomes certain, but recognition at that stage has lost its saving utility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly joins certainty to action before the deadline, while action or belief requested after disclosure cannot repair the position. This activates truth as fulfillment in deed rather than prediction alone.

activation_trace.role: Realizing a promise or conviction in action supplies the focus's performative truth criterion.
Intentional doing supplies the deed requested once certainty has arrived too late.
Repairing rather than corrupt action supplies the desired content of belated performance.
Self-restraint over time supplies the durable practice through which conviction becomes credible.
Stable knowledge supplies the inward state paired with patient outward conduct.
Belief that settles the heart supplies a response whose timing determines whether it counts.
Loss of benefit supplies the deadline after which truthful assent cannot become effective action.

structural_cues: In 32:12 the speakers ask to return and act after they see and hear; 32:24 pairs patience with certainty; 32:29 denies benefit to belief adopted on the opening day.
The focus's conditional challenge about truthful speakers is therefore surrounded by contrasts between timely and belated enactment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action, repair, endurance, certainty, and a terminal loss of benefit; I infer that fulfillment in deed is part of what makes a truth claim live. Predictive correspondence remains a valid narrower reading.

changed_reading.before: The challengers test whether the addressees predict accurately.
changed_reading.after: The challenge rebounds toward whether conviction is fulfilled in timely conduct, since assent compelled after the opening no longer performs truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearer affliction still aims at return, but the opening day removes both benefit and delay. The focus's single 'when' is thus placed at the irreversible end of a sequence containing earlier reversible thresholds.

activation_trace.role: An initiating threshold supplies the possibility that one event opens a new temporal regime.
A final ruling supplies the irreversible threshold beyond corrective warnings.
Nearness supplies a proximal intervention before the greater terminal event.
Turning back from a course supplies the still-reversible purpose of the nearer warning.
A day marked by its event and severity supplies the terminal temporal boundary.
The end of benefit supplies the irreversible side of that boundary.
Withheld extension supplies the absence of additional time once the boundary is crossed.

structural_cues: 32:21 contrasts nearer and greater affliction and gives return as the nearer event's purpose; 32:29 denies both benefit and respite on the opening day.
The definite demonstrative construction in the focus compresses this staged sequence into 'this opening.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a corrective near stage and a no-benefit, no-extension day; I infer a sequence of reversible warning followed by irreversible opening. A live alternative is that the two passages name unrelated kinds of consequence.

changed_reading.before: The opening is one isolated future point.
changed_reading.after: The opening is the irreversible culmination of earlier chances to turn back, so asking only for its date ignores the operative thresholds already present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly places the separation of parties and their differences on a day. This sharply activates the judicial branch of the focus opening without eliminating victory or access readings.

activation_trace.role: Judgment that breaks closure supplies the focus event's adjudicative mechanism.
Truth against falsehood supplies the contested issue that adjudication resolves.
A ruling that distinguishes truth from falsehood supplies the direct functional parallel to judicial opening.
The interval between parties supplies the relational space across which the ruling separates them.
A day defined by its decisive event supplies the temporal frame later requested by 'when.'
Taking divergent paths supplies the substantive disagreement that requires separation.

structural_cues: Only three ayat before the focus, 32:25 combines a separating verb, parties, a named day, and their ongoing disagreement.
The focus then frames its opening as the test of rival truth claims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit day of separating disagreement and the focus supplies a judgment-capable opening; I infer that both instantiate the same dispute-resolution function. The triumph branch remains live because judicial and contestive outcomes can coincide without being identical.

changed_reading.before: The opening is chiefly a victory over opponents.
changed_reading.after: The opening is also the judicial separation of positions that presently remain entangled in disagreement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, water is deliberately driven into barren ground, something latent emerges, growth follows, and dependents consume it. This activates opening as release through a channel that changes a closed substrate's productivity.

activation_trace.role: Water issuing through an aperture supplies the material analogue for the focus opening.
A blocked passage becoming open supplies the channel change that makes release possible.
Directed driving supplies the agency that moves the resource toward the blocked or barren recipient.
Delivery by watering supplies the medium conducted through the opened route.
Ground stripped of vegetation supplies the initially closed, nonproductive substrate.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the emergence caused by the release.
Germination and growth supply the productive transformation downstream of opening.
Consumable provision supplies the distributed benefit produced by the opened life-channel.

structural_cues: 32:27 is the immediately preceding process scene: directed water, barren land, emergence, crop, and shared consumption, followed by a failed-sight question.
32:28 names an opening without specifying a material domain, leaving the focus root's water-release branch available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every stage of the material process, while I supply the arrow that treats it as an analogue for what opening does. The alternative is that 32:27 is only evidence for power and does not color the noun in 32:28.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a sudden military or judicial result.
changed_reading.after: The opening can also be modeled as managed release into a barren system: it exposes latent life, generates yield, and redistributes benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct answer binds the focus opening to a day when belief gives no benefit and no extension is granted; the next ayah answers waiting with reciprocal waiting. The apparently informational 'when' becomes a tactic inside a deadline standoff.

activation_trace.role: Speaking back and forth over an affair supplies the negotiated surface of the timing challenge.
A decisive ruling supplies the deadline that cannot remain an object of negotiation.
The repeated opening directly identifies the answer's day as the moment of settlement.
A day defined by its decisive occurrence supplies the answer to the focus's temporal demand without giving a date.
The cessation of benefit supplies the deadline's substantive consequence.
Denied respite supplies the refusal to extend the very schedule the question tries to control.
Turning one's side away supplies disengagement from further bargaining over the date.
Reciprocal waiting supplies the standoff that replaces attempted timetable extraction.

structural_cues: 32:28 asks when; 32:29 repeats the same opening noun inside a day construction but answers with consequences rather than a date; 32:30 repeats waiting on both sides.
The answer's syntax reverses control: the challengers ask for a schedule, but the response defines what their state will be when it arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct adjacency, lexical repetition, denied benefit, denied extension, and mirrored waiting; I infer that the timing question is also a maneuver for control or delay. It may instead be pure mockery, but even then the answer preserves the reversal of agency.

changed_reading.before: The challengers control the exchange by demanding a date that would verify the claim.
changed_reading.after: Their demand is reversed into a deadline warning: the important fact is not the date but that no profitable response or extra time remains once it arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus speech root into a smallness-and-motion root and transfers bodily instability into discourse. It remains anchored because that mapped target is explicitly supplied for focus word 1 and an explicit smallness occurrence earlier keeps the branch family active. Render it only as affective texture in the speakers' manner, not as a lexical gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 is resolved by the packet to a secondary target whose agitation branches can color the repeated plural saying.

activation_trace.role: Trembling under fear or anger supplies an affective tremor beneath the apparently controlled question.
Unsettled movement supplies a discourse that keeps shifting because it cannot establish a stable position.
Explicit insufficiency earlier in the packet keeps the secondary root family audible as a deficit rather than a direct meaning of speech.

changed_reading.before: The repeated question is a composed and fully stable taunt.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the repeated saying also betrays agitation and insufficiency: demanding a fixed date is an attempt to stabilize a position already in motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is derivationally and socially distant from the ordinary predicative sense of truthful speakers, so it should not replace propositional truth. It remains valid as latent activation because the focus truth root includes a branch of giving or relinquishing a due, while 32:16 joins apportioned provision to expenditure. Render it as an ethical resonance: truth may cost the claimant something before the deadline.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The truth root at focus word 7 carries a branch in which truth is enacted through transferred wealth or relinquished right.

activation_trace.role: Giving wealth or yielding a due supplies a costly, material performance of truthfulness.
An apportioned gift supplies the resource from which truth can be materially enacted.
Wealth leaving possession supplies the concrete relinquishment that distinguishes costly commitment from verbal challenge.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness is verified only by whether a forecast comes true.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, truthfulness is also verified by timely relinquishment: the speakers demand proof while the context asks what their own conviction costs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is paradoxical because an opening normally suggests freer passage, whereas the context presents prepared reception on one side and failed exit with forced return on the other. It remains anchored in the focus opening's passage branch and in explicit movement into, out of, and back into destinations. Render it as an asymmetric threshold produced by judgment, not as a claim that the focus noun lexically means closure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening at focus word 4 can organize the destination and failed-exit scenes as a threshold whose direction differs by party.

activation_trace.role: A closure becoming passable supplies the gate image whose asymmetry the context exposes.
Prepared reception for an arriving guest supplies open admission on one side of the threshold.
Being gathered into an abode supplies enclosure on the other side.
Attempted passage to the outside supplies the expected use of an opening.
Forced return after departure supplies the reversal that makes the threshold one-way.

changed_reading.before: Opening grants a common passage from closure to access.
changed_reading.after: The opening may be asymmetric: it admits some to prepared reception while the same settlement closes effective exit or revision for others.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a generic date challenge to a speech-event test in which words become manifest, experienced, and no longer negotiable.
The day of separating disagreement and the direct no-benefit, no-respite answer strongly activate an irreversible judicial deadline without eliminating victory.
The immediately preceding water-to-barren-land process preserves a distinct material model of opening as managed release that exposes latent life and distributes yield.
The seeing, hearing, certainty, action, and belated-belief sequence changes truth from prediction alone into timely perception and enacted commitment.
summary.what_was_special: The four focus roots form a compact circuit from saying, through opening and occurrence, to truth. Context activates judicial, temporal, perceptual, material, and ethical mechanisms around that circuit, while the packet's split mapping keeps an affective instability reading alive at the exploratory edge.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the opening is primarily adjudication, triumph, or a deliberately polysemous threshold remains unresolved.
The perceptual and hydrological models may describe how the event works or what precedes it rather than directly identify its referent.
The secondary speech-to-instability mapping and truth-to-giving resonance are packet-licensed but form-distant and require explicit qualification.
